scope: Same eight fixed admitted TRAIN batches, 512 exposures, 423 canonical-teacher-correct rows; no evaluation or ownership GT
near_definition: Union of canonical and detached student Top-5; ground truth excluded; teacher-correct rows only

all_gap_remaining_loss.gradient_limit: Energy fraction is NOT a fraction of gradient norm or causal learning effect. Near loss uses a different denominator; its larger gradient also reflects rescaling.

interpretation: The all-class average regularizer substantially reduces broad logit-gap drift, while decision-near gap preservation remains incomplete. Nine teacher-correct TRAIN cases still flip, and most remaining squared-deficit energy lies outside the union of Top-5 candidates. This supports a controlled near-rival objective experiment, not a claim that it will improve fresh handwriting or that the existing loss is numerically incorrect.
